text_blocks.snippet: Pre-glued lash clusters feature a pre-applied, pressure-sensitive adhesive band that lets you apply extensions under your natural lashes in a single step without liquid glue or drying time.
snippet_highlighted_words: a pre-applied, pressure-sensitive adhesive band that lets you apply extensions under your natural lashes in a single step without liquid glue or drying time

list.snippet: Prep: Curl your natural lashes and wipe your application tool clean.
Pluck: Gently grab a lash cluster from the tray using tweezers or an applicator, avoiding touching the sticky band.
Place: Look down into a mirror and press the cluster underneath your natural lash line (starting from the outer or inner corner depending on the brand map).
Clamp: Squeeze or clamp your natural lashes and the cluster together to secure the bond.

references.title: VeyesBeauty Soft Trio Cluster Lash Self Adhesive Eyelash Extensions
references.snippet: VeyesBeauty Self-Adhesive Lashes in 'Soft Trio' are here to revolutionize your lash game. Give you a gorgeous selection of pre-glued cluster lashes that stick right on in seconds—no sticky glue, no drying wait, and no fuss. Each lash cluster features a gentle, pre-applied adhesive that activates with a gentle press. Simply choose your style, position it along your lash line, and press to secure. Perfect for beginners, busy mornings, or touch-ups on the go. The 'Soft Trio' mix includes multiple lengths and densities, allowing you to create a custom, natural to medium-glam look that enhances your eyes without looking overdone. Crafted from high-quality, feather-light synthetic fibers, these lashes are incredibly comfortable and designed to be reusable. Get stunning, eye-opening dimension that lasts all day.

references.title: Ardell Press-On Pre-Glued Underlash Extensions
references.snippet: Ardell Press On Faux Mink Natural are pre-glued lash clusters that deliver richer, fuller lashes with medium volume and medium length for an elegant, natural-looking finish. This value pack includes 60 lash clusters in five lengths ranging from 8 mm to 14 mm, with specially angled inner clusters for a seamless fit at the inner corner. Rich black fibers darken and define the lash line, giving your eyelashes added depth without bulk. These eyelash extensions are applied under your natural lashes so the bands stay completely hidden with no contact with your skin. Speedhesive Technology on the pre-glued band delivers a fast, secure all-day hold without any glue mess or drying time. Use the applicator to place each lash cluster under your lash line from outer to inner corner, then seal in place. Ardell makes beautiful, defined eyelashes with glue already built in, perfect for beginners and pros alike.

references.title: Kiss imPRESS Press On Falsies Refills
references.snippet: The KISS Products imPRESS Press-on Falsies Voluminous eyelash extensions kit is designed for effortless beauty. Offering a lightweight experience, these falsies ensure comfort while enhancing your natural look. Lasting up to 24 hours, they provide a reliable solution for any occasion, keeping your lashes in perfect shape without the need for glue. The invisible lash band and seamless fit elevate the aesthetic, making them undetectable to the eye. The pre-bonded technology and flexible band contribute to a simple application process that eliminates the hassle often associated with traditional eyelash extensions. These features, combined with a damage-free and residue-free formula, assure that your natural lashes remain unharmed, allowing you to enjoy beautiful lashes without stress.
